text:
samira (PM): quick sync: TradFiCorp wants tenant-held keys + an immutable 5yr audit lane for only audit_logs+evidence. they also want an 'emergency extension' flow we can trigger for legal callbacks. can we scope a pilot and pricing bands?

ev an (legal): we need a clear escrow/escrow-exemption doc. if keys stay tenant-owned we must prove we never had access (KMS attest + non-exporting SDK). legal wants an artifact we can sign off to procurement. :memo:

kai (eng-infra): technical notes: three retention tiers = 90d / 1y / 5y. archival stored as cold immutable objects with append-only manifests. full search across 5y is off for pilot; exports only. API idea (support-only pilot): PATCH /tenants/{id}/retention {"tier":"archival","scopes":["audit_logs","evidence"]} and POST /tenants/{id}/exports {"from":"2021-01-01","to":"2026-01-01","format":"tar.gz"}.

ruth (ops): escape hatch proposal: support ticket + customer admin signed consent + 2x SRE approvals -> temp_extension <=30d -> auto-revert. we hash and store the signed consent in the audit stream BEFORE applying change. also require 2FA for ops approvals.

mohit (sales): procurement asks: can we cap monthly archival spend for first 12 months? customer willing to pay for Console toggle on GA. for pilot they accept support-only but want export SLA and a one-pager.

compliance-bot: job queued: tradfi BYOK onboarding #23321 status: pending-review

samira (PM): open decisions: 1) pilot mode support-only vs self-serve 2) billing: onboarding flat fee + per-GB archival vs tiered subscription 3) temporary extension policy (max days) 4) required artifacts for procurement.

ev an (legal): mandatory gates: - KMS attestation + HSM cert chain if requested - export manifest format + signed-by proof - retention-change approval artifact - legal_hold flag semantics documented. No GA BYOK until legal signoff.

kai (eng-infra): manifest sketch for export (ops will deliver signed bundle):
```
manifest.json
{
  "tenant_id": "T-TRADFI",
  "export_id": "exp-23321",
  "generated_at": "2025-06-01T12:00:00Z",
  "files": [
    {"path":"audit/2021-01-01.log.gz","sha256":"abcd...1234","size_bytes":1234567},
    {"path":"evidence/evidence-2023-03-05.tar.gz","sha256":"efgh...5678","size_bytes":2345678}
  ],
  "kms_key_ids": ["cust-kms-1"],
  "signed_by": "service-key-v2",
  "customer_signature": "optional-customer-sig-b64"
}
```
Note: manifest is also stored immutably and signed.

ruth (ops): runbook bits: verify-keystore-ownership -> store proof hash, require customer-signed consent PDF -> compute SHA256 and write to audit log, schedule export job, verify file checksums after export, produce manifest, deliver to customer via secure bucket and record delivery receipt. on-call play: failed checksum -> retry + page SRE.

mohit (sales): pricing proposal: onboarding fee $5k + archival $0.02/GB/month banded (0-10TB, 10-100TB, 100TB+). pilot can have a 12-month cap option that triggers alerts and hands-off writes if exceeded (contractual override).

ev an (legal): add escrow-exemption clause: we never accept customer keys into our HSM; we only store key metadata and references. if customer asks for escrow we need a separate legal/infrastructure flow.

kai (eng-infra): risks: cold-restore latency, export SLOs, index size. mitigation: keep a tiny metadata index (file-level) for export queries; no full-text indexing. export SLO pilot = 48h, GA target = 12h.

samira (PM): MVP (pilot): - Support-assisted BYOK onboarding - Support-only retention toggle (<=30d temporary) - Immutable export bundles with manifest + sha256 + service signature + optional customer signature - Billing: onboarding fee + per-GB/month archival; optional 12-month cap by contract - Legal_hold flag and approval artifact storage - Launch gates: KMS attestation doc, legal signoff, ops runbook, cost estimate reviewed.

ruth (ops): ops-only extension flow: record approvals, schedule auto-revert, and emit metric event retention.extension to telemetry. we should also emit a billing_event when extension flips.

mohit (sales): i'll draft the one-pager and run pricing scenarios. procurement will want the attestation artifact format and the export SLA in writing.

ev an (legal): require retention-change audit trail to include approver ids, timestamp, and hash of customer consent doc. add to gates.

samira (PM): actions: kai -> storage + cost EOW; evan -> draft legal artifact & escrow-exemption language Tue; ruth -> ops runbook Wed; mohit -> one-pager Thu. pilot slot Q2 (support-only); GA Q3 self-serve if gates satisfied. I'll open a feature card and tag owners.

compliance-bot: job #23321 moved to staging-awaiting-runbook

kai (eng-infra): small note: CLI stub for ops export:
```
redwood ops export --tenant T-TRADFI --export-id exp-23321 --out /tmp/tradfi-evidence.tar.gz
```

samira (PM): thanks all. keep threads short and update the feature card. :sparkles:
